mapper.sql: WHERE D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND D.EXCP_APLY_YN = 'N' AND E.LINK_SYS_CD = #{linkSysCd}
CASE D.DSBLTY_GRD_CD WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 'EMERGENCY' WHEN 'CAUTION' THEN 'WARNING' ELSE D.DSBLTY_GRD_CD END
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_NOCS, SUM(CASE WHEN IN ('EMERGENCY','HIGH') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CRITICAL_NOCS, SUM(CASE WHEN D.DSBLTY_JGMT_CD = 'SERVICE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SERVICE_NOCS, SUM(CASE WHEN D.DSBLTY_END_DT IS NOT NULL OR D.PRCS_STTS_CD = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS COMPLETE_NOCS, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN D.DSBLTY_END_DT IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT, D.DSBLTY_END_DT) END), 0) AS AVG_RECOVERY_SEC, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN D.DSBLTY_END_DT IS NOT NULL OR D.PRCS_STTS_CD = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) END AS COMPLETE_RATE FROM dsblty_info D LEFT JOIN eqpmnt_info E ON E.EQPMNT_SN = D.EQPMNT_SN

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT,'%Y-%m-%d') AS reportDate, COUNT(*) AS totalNocs, SUM(CASE WHEN ='EMERGENCY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS emergencyNocs, SUM(CASE WHEN ='HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS highNocs, SUM(CASE WHEN ='LOW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lowNocs, SUM(CASE WHEN ='WARNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS warningNocs, SUM(CASE WHEN ='INFO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS infoNocs FROM dsblty_info D LEFT JOIN eqpmnt_info E ON E.EQPMNT_SN=D.EQPMNT_SN
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT,'%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY reportDate

SELECT L.LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd, L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm, COUNT(D.DSBLTY_NO) AS totalNocs, SUM(CASE WHEN ='EMERGENCY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS emergencyNocs, SUM(CASE WHEN ='HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS highNocs, SUM(CASE WHEN ='LOW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lowNocs, SUM(CASE WHEN ='WARNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS warningNocs, SUM(CASE WHEN ='INFO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS infoNocs FROM link_sys_info L LEFT JOIN eqpmnt_info E ON E.LINK_SYS_CD=L.LINK_SYS_CD AND E.USE_YN='Y' LEFT JOIN dsblty_info D ON D.EQPMNT_SN=E.EQPMNT_SN AND D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND D.EXCP_APLY_YN='N' WHERE L.USE_YN='Y' AND L.LINK_SYS_CD=#{linkSysCd} GROUP BY L.LINK_SYS_CD,L.LINK_SYS_NM ORDER BY FIELD(L.LINK_SYS_CD,'VMS','PBX','SCADA_SEC','EMS_PIDS','EMS_TX')

SELECT S.STN_CD AS stnCd, S.STN_NM AS stnNm, COUNT(D.DSBLTY_NO) AS totalNocs, SUM(CASE WHEN ='EMERGENCY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS emergencyNocs, SUM(CASE WHEN ='HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS highNocs, SUM(CASE WHEN ='LOW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lowNocs, SUM(CASE WHEN ='WARNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS warningNocs, SUM(CASE WHEN ='INFO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS infoNocs FROM stn_info S LEFT JOIN eqpmnt_info E ON E.STN_CD=S.STN_CD AND E.USE_YN='Y' LEFT JOIN dsblty_info D ON D.EQPMNT_SN=E.EQPMNT_SN AND D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND D.EXCP_APLY_YN='N' WHERE S.USE_YN='Y' AND S.MNLS_STN_YN='N' AND E.LINK_SYS_CD=#{linkSysCd} GROUP BY S.STN_CD,S.STN_NM,S.STN_SEQ HAVING COUNT(D.DSBLTY_NO)>0 ORDER BY S.STN_SEQ LIMIT 20

SELECT D.DSBLTY_NO AS dsbltyNo, DATE_FORMAT(D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS ocrnDt, L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm, S.STN_NM AS stnNm, E.EQPMNT_NM AS eqpmntNm, AS gradeCd, D.DSBLTY_OCRN_CN AS faultCn, D.PRCS_STTS_CD AS prcsSttsCd, DATE_FORMAT(D.DSBLTY_END_DT,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS endDt FROM dsblty_info D LEFT JOIN eqpmnt_info E ON E.EQPMNT_SN=D.EQPMNT_SN LEFT JOIN link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=E.LINK_SYS_CD LEFT JOIN stn_info S ON S.STN_CD=E.STN_CD
ORDER BY D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT DESC LIMIT 200
